Name: Shrooms Reworked Sebastian
Author: MushroomMystic
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod reworks Sebastian to be older and more mature. He has his life planned out and is much happier in the valley. He is still a bachelor ready for love if it finds him but if you think he's just a friend, that's fine with him too![/color]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This adds a mix of plutonic and romantic events with Sebastian, perfect for people who want an older version of Sebastian whose in the middle of his career and happy to be back in the valley. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Thank you Kantrip for the insperation to make my own aged up version![/color]
